Problem: You have a strategy but you can't execute it every day. Markets move 24/7, you have work, sleep, life. You miss moves. You can't stick to your plan consistently.
That's where trading bots help. WhiteBIT has Grid and DCA bots that execute your strategy automatically 24/7.
Grid Bot: You set a price range (like Bitcoin $49k-$51k). Bot automatically places buy orders when price drops, sell orders when it rises. Captures dozens of small trades daily without you doing anything. Market breaks out of your range? You can adjust it mid-execution without losing progress.
DCA Bot: Instead of buying $10k at once, bot splits it into smaller purchases over time. Removes timing risk, forces discipline. You can manually add orders if market crashes deeper, or close the cycle and take profits whenever you want.
Both bots let you stay in control. You adjust parameters as needed. Bot does the repetitive execution.
The catch? Bots execute what you program. Bad strategy = bad execution, just faster. They're a tool, not magic.
